WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.location_id) r.* FROM gym.ezf_active_membership_sync_runs r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gym.ezf_active_memberships m WHERE m.location_id = r.location_id AND m.report_as_of = r.report_as_of AND m.source_csv_sha256 = r.source_csv_sha256) ORDER BY r.location_id, r.report_as_of DESC, r.started_at DESC), counts AS (SELECT location_id, report_as_of, source_csv_sha256, COUNT(*) AS projection_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE bridge_class = 'MATCHED_INDIVIDUAL' AND member_id IS NOT NULL) AS recounted_members FROM gym.ezf_active_memberships GROUP BY location_id, report_as_of, source_csv_sha256) SELECT l.id AS location_id, CASE WHEN r.status = 'complete' AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND r.report_filter_version = 'ezfacility-memberships-by-status-owner-filters-v1' AND r.had_errors = false AND r.parse_drift = false AND r.structural_differences = 0 AND r.unmapped_members = 0 AND r.unexplained_records = 0 AND c.projection_rows = r.unique_membership_keys AND c.recounted_members = r.active_individual_members THEN c.recounted_members ELSE NULL END AS active_individual_members, r.report_as_of AS source_report_date, r.finished_at AS fetched_at, r.structural_differences FROM gym.locations l LEFT JOIN latest r ON r.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.location_id = r.location_id AND c.report_as_of = r.report_as_of AND c.source_csv_sha256 = r.source_csv_sha256 ORDER BY l.id

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.location_id) r.* FROM gym.ezf_active_membership_sync_runs r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gym.ezf_active_memberships m WHERE m.location_id = r.location_id AND m.report_as_of = r.report_as_of AND m.source_csv_sha256 = r.source_csv_sha256) ORDER BY r.location_id, r.report_as_of DESC, r.started_at DESC), counts AS (SELECT location_id, report_as_of, source_csv_sha256, COUNT(*) AS projection_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE bridge_class = 'MATCHED_INDIVIDUAL' AND member_id IS NOT NULL) AS recounted_members FROM gym.ezf_active_memberships GROUP BY location_id, report_as_of, source_csv_sha256) SELECT l.id AS location_id, CASE WHEN r.status = 'complete' AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND r.report_filter_version = 'ezfacility-memberships-by-status-owner-filters-v1' AND r.had_errors = false AND r.parse_drift = false AND r.structural_differences = 0 AND r.unmapped_members = 0 AND r.unexplained_records = 0 AND c.projection_rows = r.unique_membership_keys AND c.recounted_members = r.active_individual_members THEN c.recounted_members ELSE NULL END AS active_individual_members, r.report_as_of AS source_report_date, r.finished_at AS fetched_at FROM gym.locations l LEFT JOIN latest r ON r.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.location_id = r.location_id AND c.report_as_of = r.report_as_of AND c.source_csv_sha256 = r.source_csv_sha256 ORDER BY l.id

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.location_id) r.location_id, r.report_as_of FROM gym.ezf_active_membership_sync_runs r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gym.ezf_active_memberships m WHERE m.location_id = r.location_id AND m.report_as_of = r.report_as_of AND m.source_csv_sha256 = r.source_csv_sha256) ORDER BY r.location_id, r.report_as_of DESC, r.started_at DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(r.report_as_of) = COUNT(*) THEN MIN(r.report_as_of) ELSE NULL END AS data_as_of FROM gym.locations l LEFT JOIN latest r ON r.location_id = l.id
